packageRules.description: The workflow's renovate-version input resolves to ghcr.io/renovatebot/renovate. default.json leaves this image on the docker datasource, which reads no GHCR dates, because it pushes 100 versions within hours and the GitHub Packages API datasource (custom.ghcr) reads only the newest 100; the shared 4-day soak would hold it forever. docker.io/renovate/renovate publishes the same index digests (44.107.0: sha256:fb6b7c66be211ee72de037eb48d269da7cf90f30c773e893b6b8002bffafcd4b on both) with tag_last_pushed dates, so look tags up there. overrideDatasource: docker keeps the lookup on Docker Hub even if default.json ever stops excluding the image from custom.ghcr. The action still pulls from GHCR, so a Docker Hub tag without a GHCR counterpart would break the runner: validate.yml checks on every PR that the pinned renovate-version exists on GHCR and Docker Hub with the same index digest.
